title: Through Traffic
author: Jordan Taylor
problems: Row 3 "square through four - partners balance & pull by right, then neighbors pull by left, then repeat · pull by": a dancer has to turn 0.66 turns in one beat (with 3 couples).
choices: A balance with a partner or neighbor holds both hands.
Square through: each balance takes 4 beats and each pull by 2.
